title: Listening keeps the sound
summary: Every moment your Mac or iPhone hears is kept as a recording in Files, with each line placed in it, so you can play back or clip anything said.

payload.title: Every moment, kept as sound
payload.body: Each moment your Mac or iPhone hears is now kept as a recording in Files, under Recordings, Listening, one folder a day. Every line said is placed in it with who said it, so searching a line takes you to that moment, ready to play or cut as a clip.

payload.title: Kept until you delete it
payload.body: The sound stays in your own files until you delete it, like any recording. Say "stop listening" or turn listening off in Record whenever you want it to stop.
